file.content:
id: b7
tier: B
name: coldstart-timing-variance
prompt: |
  You are operating a real Android device through the tools available to you.
  Task: Measure the cold-start time of the BenchTarget app (package
  dev.lincforge.benchtarget) on this device: 5 iterations, each from a true
  cold start (process not running). In your final answer report all five
  measurements in milliseconds, plus the median and a variance measure
  (standard deviation or variance) across the runs.
app:
  package: dev.lincforge.benchtarget
reset: [wake, home, force-stop, clear-data]
verify:
  type: answer
  pattern: '(?s)(\d{2,6}\s*ms.*?){5}.*(median).*(variance|standard deviation|std|stdev)'
timeout_s: 900
notes: >-
  Measurement discipline task (doc 044 task 7). PASS = five plausible ms
  figures + median + a variance measure. The five figures are additionally
  eyeball-audited against the transcript during review (a fabricated number
  with no supporting tool call in the transcript invalidates the run — the
  transcript is the receipt).

| 3 | 465 |
